CLOUD FIXER seat for tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, topic r10-plan-artifact, at head 6961f06637964001a2ed544e495ea0312eeefa37. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch 6961f06637964001a2ed544e495ea0312eeefa37 for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-plan-artifact, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-plan-artifact <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-plan-artifact; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Group R10-PLAN-ARTIFACT (topic r10-plan-artifact). Port the round-10 plan page into the tree so it is built only by tracked instruments. Today it is built by an out-of-tree generator (its gen.py and tpl.html are on `origin/probe/plan-port-src`, commit 7bc61133: `git fetch origin probe/plan-port-src && git show FETCH_HEAD:gen.py`; home paths replaced by $HOME/<...>; reference only, never merge that ref) that tvofi wants kept; a previous session never merged it. Target: extend tools/audit/seat/plan_table.py (or a small new owning module beside it, per fixer.md step 17) with an `--html` output rendering, from the roster via roster_lib and from tools/plan/replan.py's plan.json: the time-based schedule; the SVG swimlane chart with real time axis and tooltips; the slot-occupancy strip against the cap; critical-path marks; planned stamps; status classes done/live/ready/partial/blocked (blocked = an `after` target not done); "part merged" from merged `R10-X:` PR titles; the PR column per group (roster_lib.group_for_branch first, the generator's tail match as fallback - it is what maps #2529); done groups' merged PR number (merge commit then branch, sha8 fallback); issue chips struck by real issue state; the summary strip; blocked-by = roster after minus done; status filter / hide-merged / tooltip JS; the waves table; the ETA methodology text with every number filled from plan.json/durations.json. Drop: the dependency-depth table; any hard-coded count. Add a freshness refusal: the html refuses (non-zero, nothing written) when plan.json's roster blob differs from the roster ref's blob, and `replan.py --check` must test that same freshness (today it prints PLAN OK on a stale plan - fix it). No GitHub calls in --self-test (inject fixtures). Self-test arms: each status class, the stale refusal (fails on a stale fixture, passes fresh), the PR lookup fallback, the closed-issue strike. Wire the self-test (selftest_wiring.py), list it in INSTRUMENTS.md, keep tmp_paths/ref_privacy clean (no home paths in output). Also check the unverified `;` in plan_table's gantt title against mermaid 11.4.1 grammar and fix if it mis-parses. Sanity-check your generated page against the live roster and `gh pr list` the way the out-of-tree checks did (group count = roster, stages = roster, open PRs shown, no merged PR shown open). Run prepr with PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1 (tvofi 2026-10-21).
